entries.api: dex2oat-once toolchain (dex2oat-once T7): host dex2oat64 (T3c, r1 tree + 22-patch series, explicit suspend-check / implicit_suspend_checks_=false) + t5_gen_image.sh generator that produce a board-R155-compatible 27-file boot image offline; verified image-only (T5c/T6c) and image+stubs-jar package (T7c). Freezes the toolchain that regenerates boot classes (tagsoup, MediaStore, boot-api stubs) without a decommissioned build machine.
entries.source_record: branch master; recipe knowledge/toolchains/art-r155/{patches (22), series, BUILD.md, recipe/}; build env BUILD.md §T3c (ART_USE_READ_BARRIER=false, ART_DEFAULT_GC_TYPE=CMS, ART_USE_GENERATIONAL_CC=false, ART_HEAP_POISONING=false, ART_TEST_DEBUG_GC=false, ALLOW_MISSING_DEPENDENCIES=true; m -j32 dex2oat); reproducible per scripts/lab/reproduce_dex2oat_toolchain.sh (dex2oat64 byte-for-byte ae865ddd, image vdex 9/9 == T5c, only boot.art/boot.oat differ by embedded cmdline path string). Board R155 device libart 59e1bb45 is a GATE REFERENCE only (not deployed by this toolchain).
